description: This file defines the Ext.ux.menu.ListMenu class, a custom menu component extending Ext.menu.Menu, used for displaying a list with checkable items, supporting dynamic data loading and selection management within the Ext JS 3.3.0 framework.

classes.name: Ext.ux.menu.ListMenu
classes.description: A custom menu class for displaying a list of checkable items with dynamic data loading, used as a supporting component for grid filters.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the ListMenu, sets up event handling, and manages data options or store.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources, destroys the data store if present.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays the menu, optionally loading data if configured to do so.

methods.name: onLoad
methods.description: Handles data load event, populates menu items based on records.

methods.name: getSelected
methods.description: Returns the array of selected item IDs.

methods.name: setSelected
methods.description: Sets the selected items based on provided values.

methods.name: checkChange
methods.description: Handles check/uncheck events, updates selected items, and fires 'checkchange' event.
